svg.title: Which cells start events in Vale
svg.desc: A screen of Vale on the day the story begins, drawn from its map, with each cell that carries one of the scene's own collision codes tinted and numbered. In pink, cells that a touch row answers, where stepping on or walking into the cell runs an event: 1, a door into a house, walking north into it; 2, the door into Isaac's house, walking north; 3, the ladder up onto the roof of Isaac's house, walking north; 4, the ladder down from the roof, walking south; 5, the cell where stepping off the upper path changes its cells back. In grey, 6: three cells of the path at the top with a code of the scene's own that no row answers, so nothing happens there. The same code can mean something else in another place, because each scene's event table says what its codes do.
svg.text: VALE, THE DAY THE STORY BEGINS
Pink: a touch row runs an event there.
Grey: the scene's own code, but no row.
